newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allocates 82.4 bln marks at fixed three pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allocates 82.4 bln marks at fixed three pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it had allocated 82.4 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at a fixed three percent rate.

The central bank accepted 25.7 percent of the bids for the 14-day funds. A repo pact for 82.0 billion marks, also set at a fixed three percent rate, expires today, Wednesday, so a net 400 million marks are being added to the market.
The Bundesbank has kept its main money market rate, the repo, fixed at three percent since last August.
Banks bid for a total of 320.6 billion marks of the funds.
